component.name: OctoShield
component.summary: Manage Ubuntu laptop security profiles and live protection status

description.p: Prepare your Ubuntu laptop for conferences, shared networks, and everyday work. OctoShield brings established Linux security controls into a native GNOME application, with a complete terminal interface for administrators.

Review each protection before applying it. OctoShield explains proposed changes and uses the system's administrator authentication dialog to unlock each desktop application session. Installing the application does not turn on security controls or automatically trust connected USB devices.

ul.li: Switch editable Conference, Public, Office and Home profiles globally or for one protection, with explicit overrides and verified live status.
Configure a host firewall for Wi-Fi and Ethernet, with narrowly scoped IPv4/IPv6 port, protocol, source and interface exceptions and optional expiry.

Review and enroll trusted USB devices with USBGuard. A guided device prompt offers temporary or profile-specific access while unknown devices remain blocked; switching profiles reevaluates connected devices.
Unlock the desktop once, refresh device status without repeated password requests, and choose actions beside each connected device.
Limit automatic network connections and unnecessary services, and configure GNOME screen locking and removable-media behavior.
Review AppArmor confinement, automatic security updates, and sudo authentication settings using Ubuntu's native security mechanisms.
Monitor meaningful firewall, USB, and authentication events, and enable restrained security notifications in your desktop session.
Inspect saved action history and recovery guidance, and make selected office adjustments without globally undoing your protections.
Inspect container exposure, Thunderbolt and USB4 protection indicators, Secure Boot and encryption status, with unavailable results made explicit.
Check official releases on request and upgrade with the normal system package installer while retaining profiles, policies and recovery snapshots.

description.p: The desktop application runs as your normal user. A narrowly scoped PolicyKit-authorized session performs reviewed system changes through a fixed helper API, while desktop preferences remain in your own session. System changes are recorded with recovery snapshots; interrupted operations may need manual review.

OctoShield is maintained by Vast Development Method as part of the Octoleo suite. It supports Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 and uses Bash and C. Its controls reduce exposure but do not guarantee protection against every attack or identify passive network surveillance.

description.p: Fix package upgrades being blocked by background status inspection. Upgrades safely pause the observer, preserve protection settings, and recover when upgrading from earlier packages. Regression tests cover active observation and real protection changes.
A smoother administrator session and guided USB approval flow, with live device state and explicit temporary or profile-specific trust.

ul.li: Authenticate once when opening the application and retain access for that application session without running the desktop as root.
Review newly blocked USB devices in a guided prompt, choose once or the effective USB profile, and keep cancelled requests blocked.
Refresh and manage connected devices with clear status and direct actions; reject decisions if the attachment or profile changed.
Upgrade the existing Debian installation from 1.1.0 while preserving custom profiles, USB approvals and recovery information.

description.p: Manage everyday and conference protection with editable profiles, verified system status and the same controls in GNOME and the CLI.

ul.li: Switch Conference, Public, Office and Home profiles globally or per control; create custom profiles and restore captured baselines.

Configure scoped IPv4/IPv6 firewall exceptions and expiry while retaining outgoing access and avoiding firewall resets on switching. Timed rules stop granting new connections at their kernel-enforced UTC deadline or an earlier reload/reboot.
Remember USB approvals for the effective profile, reevaluate connected devices on switching and revoke remembered trust.
Inspect additional container, Thunderbolt/USB4, Secure Boot and encryption exposure with explicit unknown and incomplete states.
Check official release downloads and upgrade the existing Debian installation while retaining policies, preferences and snapshots.

description.p: The first stable OctoShield release provides installable Debian packages for Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, with native GNOME and Whiptail interfaces backed by the same security-control modules.

ul.li: Review firewall, USB authorization, network, service, sudo, security-update, AppArmor, and desktop protections before applying changes with explicit administrator authorization.
Configure trusted office access, inspect security events, and retain private configuration recovery records.
Follow the system's light or dark appearance and integrate application information and optional signed APT updates.
Install, upgrade, and remove the application without silently enabling hardening or discarding administrator-selected protections.

description.p: Introducing the native OctoShield desktop application and Debian package, alongside the standalone command-line interface.

ul.li: Review protections, USB approvals, office access, monitoring, and recovery information in a native GNOME interface.
Use the same tested security-control modules from the desktop application or terminal, with explicit administrator authorization.
Follow the desktop's light or dark appearance with the official OctoShield branding.
